NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VIII: OUR OWN STORIES, SKILLS AND FUTURE (LCH-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)

collection.description: A researcher collected plants from a family garden without asking: apologize and set rules, or argue it was for everyone's good.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject), a researcher, has been taking cuttings from (friend)'s family garden for a study, without asking, because (subject.he/she) thought nobody would mind. (friend) minds. And the village would rather (subject) studied why the spring is failing than why the flowers are blue. What should (subject) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) apologizes to (friend) and the village agrees on rules: ask first, share what you find, and study what the village needs. (subject)'s next study is the spring. It turns out to be a blocked channel under a fallen tree.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) argues that knowledge helps everyone. (friend) says that is not the point: it was (friend.his/her) garden. The gathering sides with (friend). (subject) returns the cuttings, and is sulky for a while, and then asks permission next time.
